title: Close to good but still not enough
body: Although it has improved since earlier releases, there’s still job to do. I’d like to see the option of attaching files or images to each reminder. Enabling a chime sound after tapping on completion would be awesome! Last but not least, please move the due tasks not completed to a lower position with some color to identify them as due but not completed yet.

title: Kind of good, kind of bad

It is too basic.
